_comment: mirror = packaged into this repo from upstream GitHub (missing from the official Kodi repo, or official is stale). official = installed by id from Kodi's own repo by the toolbox add-on. external = better served by the vendor's own repository.

mirror.name: a4kSubtitles
mirror.why: Multi-source subtitle search (OpenSubtitles, Addic7ed, Podnapisi, SubDL, SubSource) in one addon. Not in the official repo.

mirror.name: BlackBarsNever
mirror.why: Detects and removes black bars, including hardcoded ones, during playback.

mirror.name: Janitor
mirror.why: Deletes watched video files on a schedule to reclaim disk. Not in the official repo.

mirror.name: VPN Manager for OpenVPN
mirror.why: Connects and maintains an OpenVPN tunnel from inside Kodi, with per-addon connection rules. Not in the official repo. Unticked by default: it bundles profiles for NordVPN, ExpressVPN and PIA but not Surfshark (which needs the User Defined route and manual-setup credentials), and on Android/Fire OS an addon cannot control the system VPN -- use the provider's own app there.

official.name: Trakt
official.why: Scrobbling, watched-state sync and lists across devices.

official.name: Up Next
official.why: Netflix-style auto-play of the next episode.

official.name: Global Search
official.why: Search the whole library and addons from one dialog.

official.name: Skin Shortcuts
official.why: Menu customisation; required by most good skins.

official.name: Keymap Editor
official.why: Remap remote and keyboard buttons from the GUI.

official.name: ExtendedInfo Script
official.why: Deep cast, similar-title and trailer browsing.

official.name: Embuary Helper
official.why: Widget and skin helper used by many modern skins.

official.name: Embuary Info
official.why: Rich info dialogs for movies, shows and people.

official.name: InputStream Adaptive
official.why: DASH/HLS/Smooth playback; required by most streaming addons.

official.name: InputStream FFmpegDirect
official.why: Timeshift and better handling of live streams.

official.name: Kodi Logfile Uploader
official.why: One-click log upload when you need support.

official.name: Autocompletion
official.why: Search suggestions in Kodi's on-screen keyboard.

official.name: Copacetic
official.why: Fast, clean, actively maintained modern skin.

official.name: PVR IPTV Simple Client
official.why: Play your own M3U playlists as live TV channels.

external.name: TheMovieDb Helper (6.x)
external.why: Newer than the official repo's 5.x, but hard-requires script.module.pil, a compiled module no official repo ships. Upstream's own repo resolves it.

external.name: Jellyfin for Kodi
external.why: Generates its addon.xml at release time and publishes an auto-updating repo.
